Legion was my name by nature
Legion was my name by nature,
Thus I was, when Jesus found me,
Filled with madness, sin and woe.
Newton printed the hymn under Mark 5:18–19. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

18As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him. 19But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.” MARK 5:18–19 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ MARK 5

“Love, he said, will sweeten labors, Thou hast something yet to do; Go and tell your friends and neighbors, What my love has done for you: Live to manifest my glory, Wait for heav’n a little space; Sinners, when they hear thy story, Will repent and seek my face.” STANZA V
